provider.title: Provider Management

validation.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a valid API URL starting with http:// or https://
validation.baseUrlEndpointNotAllowed: OpenAI-compatible provider API URL must not include /responses or /chat/completions. Enter the base URL only and choose the API protocol separately

help.baseUrl: The provider's API base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. Do not append /responses or /chat/completions; configure the URL and protocol separately
help.wireApi: Prefer Chat Completions for legacy integrations, simple chat, and full per-request control; prefer Responses for tool use, multi-step agents, GPT-5 / o-series reasoning, and less client-side state handling. For new integrations, Responses is usually the better default to evaluate first.
help.responsesToolHistoryCompat: Enable this only when follow-up turns after tool calls frequently fail with 500/502 under the Responses protocol. It rewrites tool history into a more conservative text context for better gateway compatibility, but may reduce the model's ability to continue calling tools automatically. Disabled by default and generally not recommended.
help.type: Currently only OpenAI-compatible format is supported. Most AI services (including Anthropic, Azure) are compatible
help.isActive: When disabled, all models under this provider become unavailable and existing API calls will fail

messages.confirmDisable: Are you sure to disable this provider? All AI calls using this provider will fail.

model.title: Model Management
model.pageDesc: Add and manage AI models. Auto-fill from remote when creating. Fallback models take over when primary is offline.
model.name: Model Name

placeholder.selectRemoteModel: Select a remote model to auto-fill

placeholder.inputTpmLimit: Tokens per minute limit (leave empty for unlimited)

help.code: The model's API call code, e.g. gpt-4, claude-3-opus-20240229. Must match the code accepted by the provider's API
help.type: Chat models for conversation and text generation; embedding models for knowledge base document vectorization; image models for image generation
help.contextWindow: Total token budget for one request (system prompt + history + user input + RAG context + model output). If you want the model to accept more input, increase this first. This is unrelated to the separate page_context.page_data byte budget
help.maxOutputTokens: Maximum generated tokens per request. This only limits how much the model can output in one reply and does not increase input context capacity
help.functionCalling: When enabled, the model can call tool functions. Requires the model to natively support Function Calling
help.tier: Model tier for multi-model routing. Fast = simple tasks, Premium = complex analysis. Leave unset to opt out of auto-routing
help.fallbackModel: Automatically switches to fallback model when current model is unavailable, ensuring service continuity
help.rpmLimit: Maximum requests per minute. Requests exceeding this limit are throttled to protect the provider API
help.tpmLimit: Maximum tokens per minute. Controls the total token consumption rate
help.maxImageCount: Maximum number of images per conversation upload (1-20)
help.maxImageSizeMb: Maximum size per image in MB. Images exceeding this will be rejected

typeDesc.toolkit:
Python Toolkit: Write a Tools class in the editor below. Each public method is auto-registered as an LLM-callable tool. Supports Valves env config and .zip upload.
Use cases: Call 3rd-party APIs (weather/search/translate), custom business logic, data conversion, etc.
Tip: Method docstrings and :param annotations are shown to the LLM — write clear descriptions.
typeDesc.knowledge_base:
RAG Document Q&A: Link one or more knowledge bases for automatic semantic retrieval and context injection during conversations.
Use cases: Product docs Q&A, internal knowledge search, contract/policy consultation, etc.
Tip: Adjust Top K and score threshold to balance recall and precision.
typeDesc.data_intelligence:
Data Intelligence: Let the agent query databases using natural language via Text-to-SQL, with query/create/update/delete support.
Use cases: Business data analytics, report queries, data entry assistance, etc.
Tip: Select accessible table policies below. CRUD permissions are controlled by each policy's allow_create/update/delete settings.
typeDesc.builtin:
Built-in Tools: System-predefined capabilities like web search, image generation, etc. View the tool list after creation.
Tip: Built-in tools are maintained by the platform and cannot be edited.
typeDesc.http:
HTTP Request: Declarative REST API integration. Just fill in URL, method and parameter templates — no coding needed.
Use cases: Call internal APIs, integrate SaaS services (CRM/ERP), trigger webhooks, etc.
Tip: URL supports {variable} template syntax; configure auth info in Headers.
typeDesc.email:
Email: Let the agent send emails on behalf of users during conversations. Uses platform SMTP config with domain allowlist and recipient limits.
Use cases: Auto customer replies, meeting invitations, notification sending, etc.
Tip: SMTP server must be configured in System Settings first.
typeDesc.code_execution:
Code Execution: Let the agent run Python code in a secure sandbox and return results.
Use cases: Math calculations, data processing, text format conversion, CSV/JSON parsing, etc.
Tip: Code runs in an isolated environment with module allowlist restrictions.
